title: Associate AI and Data Consultant - Galaxy Graduate Program
desc:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the Celonis Services organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:

• Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.

• Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.

• Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.

• Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.

We deliver production-ready Celonis Platform implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a Discover-and-Build approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.

In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy operational, AI-enriched solutions on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.

We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by state-of-the-art AI augmentation, allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the "eyes and ears" in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.

The Role

As an Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program, you will support the end-to-end "Discover-and-Build" journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a "Business-Critical Mindset" and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers.

The Work You’ll Do

• Support Strategic Implementations: Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.

• Execute Discover-and-Build: As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.

• AI-Forward Solutioning: Leverage your technical background to build and deploy "AI-forward" solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.

• Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring "Built-in Quality Control" in every line of code or analysis produced.

• Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to:

• Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs

• Business Apps & Product and Engineering

• Solution Architecture & Celonis Support

The Qualifications You Need

• Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.

• Technical Foundation: Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.

• Business-Critical Mindset: A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.

• Consulting DNA: You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.

• Analytical Rigor: The ability to not only focus on "What is the data saying?" and also to recommend "What should the business do, based on the findings?"

• Communication: Excellent communication skills in English and German (native/proficient on both), with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.

• You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort.

What Celonis can offer you:

• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence…

title: (Junior) Customer Service Complaints Agent - German Speaking (m/f/d)
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• End-to-End Case Management: Independently manage and resolve complex customer complaints and legal cases within deadlines, maintaining a professional, solution-oriented approach even in high-frequency environments.

• Legal Triage & Case Preparation: Screen incoming customer inquiries for legal relevance, escalate sensitive or high-risk cases appropriately, and structure case documentation to support the Legal team’s decision-making.

• GDPR & Regulatory Compliance: Handle data privacy (GDPR) requests end-to-end, ensuring strict compliance, accurate documentation, and timely follow-ups.

• Compliant & Empathetic Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and legal cases and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment & Root Cause Analysis: Identify potential legal or operational risks early, systematically analyze complaint drivers, and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a key interface between Legal, Product, and Operations to assess, mitigate, and resolve legally complex or operationally challenging customer cases.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking and/or legal field (e.g., as a paralegal / legal assistant), or a comparable qualification - career changers with customer service experience are also welcome!

• At least 1-2 years of experience handling customer inquiries with a legal and/or complaint focus, ideally in the financial services industry, customer service, or a similar role.

• Basic knowledge of contract law, data protection law, or commercial law is an advantage – willingness to familiarize yourself with new legal issues is desired.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C2 fluency (written and spoken) in German is required, along with good working proficiency in English (C1). Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Stage - Strategy & Operations (x/f/m) - mars 2027
desc:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Doctolib Prévention https://about.doctolib.fr/prevention/, une équipe d'entrepreneur(euse)s qui construit une nouvelle activité depuis 2022 avec l'ambition de transformer le système de santé vers plus de prévention. En participant à des missions très diversifiées aux côtés du Prevention Strategy Associate, vous contribuerez directement à accompagner l'effort national de virage vers une médecine plus préventive et à donner aux patients les moyens de devenir acteurs de leur santé.

 


VOS MISSIONS

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Réaliser des analyses quantitatives et améliorer les outils de mesure (enquêtes, analyses comparatives) pour évaluer l’impact des campagnes de prévention et formuler des recommandations.

 - Mener des études de marché pour soutenir le développement de Doctolib Prévention.

 - Contribuer à la priorisation de la roadmap produit et marketing.

 - Préparer les reportings internes et coordonner avec les équipes (communication, affaires publiques, autres équipes).

 - Optimiser les processus internes et produire des supports (scripts, pitchs, présentations) pour l’équipe sales.

 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES 

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

 - Êtes étudiant.e en Master 1/2 en école de commerce ou d'ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en stratégie, santé publique, ou data

 - Êtes à l'aise avec la data, l'analyse de données quantitatives et faites preuve de rigueur et d'esprit de synthèse

 - Avez un esprit entrepreneurial, une envie d'apprendre et de vous impliquer dans un projet à impact

 - Faites preuve d'adaptabilité, de flexibilité et de qualités relationnelles

Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous portez un intérêt fort pour la santé et/ou l'innovation en santé

 - Vous souhaitez monter en compétences sur des sujets variés : stratégie, data, marketing, opérations

 - Vous possédez une appétence pour le domaine des médias
   
   


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

 - Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

 - Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

 - De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

 - Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride
   
   


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - Un call RH avec Flore, Talent Partner (15 minutes)

 - Un entretien opérationnel avec Aabir Elakili, Prevention Strategy Lead (1 heure)
   
   


DÉTAILS DU POSTE

 - Stage conventionné à temps plein

 - Durée : 6 mois

 - Début souhaité : mars 2027

 - Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret

 - Rémunération : À définir selon profil

 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici https://media.doctolib.com/image/upload/mkg/file/privacy_notice_recrutement_fr_1.pdf. Veuillez contacter hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com pour toute question ou pour exercer vos droits.

title: Growth Operations Apprentice
desc:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.



Join Qonto's Growth Operations team apprentice and help build the data connections and integrations that power our growth channels. You'll work under the guidance of Hugo, our Lead Growth Operations.




➡️ What you'll do

 - Make our Growth Engine go further: You'll configure API integrations so data flows reliably between systems (Salesforce, Segment, Braze, Meta, etc.), our marketing tools and beyond.

 - Fuel outbound with data: You'll build data enrichment flows to provide the Sales teams with the best insights to convert prospect into loyal customers.

 - Boost our Paid Acquisition campaigns by owning website tracking and tagging.

 - Deliver powerful insights for business teams: You'll use SQL and Python or JavaScript, with AI tools to move faster, to turn messy data into insights teams can act on.

 - Investigate issues and improve our infrastructure: You'll take down recurring blockers and bring your own solution so the team gets stronger every time.

 - Be a sparring partner for Engineering: You’ll help challenge and shape technical choices with our engineers, so the integrations and data flows you build hold up at scale.
   
   

➡️ What we're looking for

 - Data confidence: You're comfortable with at least two of SQL, JavaScript or Python.

 - Integration mindset: You understand APIs and enjoy making different systems work together.

 - Technical and analytical background: You're studying software engineering, data science or a similar field.

 - AI-fluent: You use AI to move faster and stay critical about the output.

 - English: You can work and communicate in English every day; French is a plus.

 - Analytical: you know how to transform raw data into valuable insights for non technical stakeholders

 - Problem solver: you enjoy tackling structural issues and make other people's jobs easier with your solutions.
   
   

➡️ What we can offer you

 - Three skill sets, one team: You'll work alongside the Ops, Product and Engineering sides of Growth Operations.

 - Room to shape your path: We encourage breadth across domains, so you grow into the areas that suit you.

 - A two-year runway: We invest in your onboarding and training upfront, so you have time to grow into your own projects.
   
   

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Hugo Peurois https://www.linkedin.com/in/hugo-peurois-1b447571/, Lead Growth Operations. Hugo has spent 3+ years at Qonto, moving from Data Analytics Manager to Senior Product Manager to leading Growth Operations. He wants his team to build knowledge across several domains rather than stay in one lane, and he invests in your development to make that happen.



Perk

 - Flex schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

 - Level up. Self-service Learning & Dev platform and unlimited access to AI tools.

 - Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

 - Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

 - Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

 - Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

 - Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

 - Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs
   
   


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.



🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.

Internship · Ideal start: as soon as possible · Duration: 6 months · Paris



➡️ What you’ll do

 - Deliver real requests: You own daily SQL extracts for regulatory reporting, audits and internal controls, with growing autonomy.

 - Build dashboards people use: You create and improve the dashboards Risk & Compliance teams rely on to steer risk.

 - AI fluency: You use AI tools in your work and know where they help.

 - Curiosity for compliance: You’re interested in fintech and banking and keen to learn the regulatory context.



➡️ What we can offer you

 - Real ownership: You work on live stakeholder requests, not side projects.

 - Close mentoring: Vatsal and Omayma Nayma mentor you, with weekly 1:1 check-ins and day-to-day support.

 - Room to grow: Your scope expands as you show what you can do.

 - AI-native tooling: You get unlimited access to AI tools like Claude Code.

You’ll report to Vatsal Parekh https://www.linkedin.com/in/parekhvatsal/, Lead Risk & Compliance Engineering. title: Stage - SEO : Contenu & recherche IA (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
desc:
Vous êtes passionné(e) par le SEO, l’IA et le marketing digital, et vous voulez participer à la mission de Doctolib : améliorer la santé de tous en facilitant l'accès aux soins ?

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire SEO & IA pour rejoindre notre équipe Patient Marketing, basée à Levallois-Perret. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation et l'optimisation de nos contenus destinés à des millions de patients en France.

Votre mission : analyser et challenger nos contenus, et trouver des solutions innovantes en t'appuyant sur nos outils d'IA. Une opportunité unique de développer tes compétences en contenu, SEO, gestion de projet et IA, dans un environnement dynamique et porteur de sens.


 


VOS MISSIONS

 

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :
